# DWG test data

These unmodified test drawings come from GNU LibreDWG's public test corpus at commit `a8ccb1f314d9feb2215be67d1f6f2a3d64b2c9a0`:

- `2000-Polyline.dwg`: `test/test-data/2000/Polyline.dwg`
- `2018-Polyline.dwg`: `test/test-data/2018/Polyline.dwg`
- `2018-Text.dwg`: `test/test-data/2018/Text.dwg`

Source: https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/tree/a8ccb1f314d9feb2215be67d1f6f2a3d64b2c9a0/test/test-data

The upstream GPL v3 license is reproduced in `LICENSE` in this directory. These are decoder test drawings, not examples of inspected buildings. They verify actual DWG binary decoding, line geometry and text across two format generations; they do not establish compatibility with every real-world AutoCAD drawing.
